paragraphs.text:
Sub Learning Outcome 1.1: Features are of sufficient complexity and in
sufficient quantity and acceptable quality for the
context. Contributions are finished (merged to
master branch) and deployed.
(Evidence: Git commits, feature/bug “tickets” finished)

Sub Learning Outcome 1.1: Learner is maintaining multiple environments for
the project. All environments are working and it is
possible to easily deploy new versions by
following the written documentation.
(Evidence: Git commits, deployment scripts or other
deployment setup)

Sub Learning Outcome 1.1: CI/CD server is functional, runs the test suite
automatically and is used for deployments. Code
quality and test coverage is visible.
(Evidence: Existence of CI/CD server, CI/CD-related scripts
and setup)

Sub Learning Outcome 1.1: The learner correctly identified areas for
improvement (in terms of team/project
management or performance). Solutions were
suggested and implemented and positive results
are demonstrably achieved. (Evidence: Agile KPI’s, meeting minutes, executive summary reports)

Sub Learning Outcome 1.2: The learner can show how they contributed to the
transparency and decision-making processes in
their team. (Evidence: Meeting minutes Tickets, boards and comments on GitHub Code review (comments on Pull Requests))

Sub Learning Outcome 2.1: The learner created automated test scripts in
sufficient quantity and quality standards, or
created scripts to help with execution of the test
suite. (Evidence: Git commits, scripts to run the test suite)

Sub Learning Outcome 2.1: Security audit was completed with issues
identified and patches suggested. Ideally some (or
all) vulnerabilities have been patched. (Evidence: Security audit document)

Sub Learning Outcome 2.1: Learner made correct use of Pull Requests and/or
contributed to other members’ Pull Requests in a
constructive way. (Evidence: Pull Requests, comments)

Sub Learning Outcome 2.2: Positive changes are made or constructive dialog
started in response to team/lecturer feedback.

Sub Learning Outcome 1.1: It was an induvidual project rather than a group project. Not used project but did his project individually. CI/CD pipleline is working. He is a good knowladge about CI/CD pipeline. - Student Specific Comments
Sub Learning Outcome 1.2: Shubham supported a bit. But not the Rishi. - Student Specific Comments
Sub Learning Outcome 2.1: GitHub  for versioning and GitHub Projects for project management. Kali things not done but will do them and submit. - Student Specific Comments
Sub Learning Outcome 2.2: We learned a lot form these coruse so many things give to us. Total exprience was good. You learned something - Student Specific Comments
